reason: The 30-minute nightly prep angle fits my schedule, but $49 a month is tough to justify on my salary when the pitch admits quotes may carry a 10 to 20 minute delay.
objection: Paying $49/mo for delayed public market data feels off when free screeners already show delayed prices.
would_change_my_mind: Drop an EOD daily watchlist tier to $25-$29/mo or clearly include real-time exchange data at $49.
